terms.task:flush_state_after_a_turn_or_at_shut: Flush state after a turn or at shutdown

terms.task:rewrite_outgoing_text_or_cancel_a_s: Rewrite outgoing text or cancel a send

caveats.before_agent_finalize: `before_agent_finalize` runs only when a harness is about to accept a natural final assistant answer.

descs.after_compaction: Observe compaction boundaries; no rewrite or veto result
descs.after_tool_call: Observe tool results, errors, and duration
descs.agent_end: Observe final messages, success state, and run duration
descs.agent_turn_prepare: Inspect drained plugin turn injections and add context before prompt hooks
descs.before_agent_finalize: Inspect the natural final answer and request one more model pass
descs.before_agent_reply: Short-circuit the model turn with a synthetic reply or silence
descs.before_agent_run: Inspect prompt and session messages before model submission; node turns gate Gateway input before worker-local context assembly
descs.before_channel_ingress: Transform a raw channel event before durable storage; failures refuse intake
descs.before_compaction: Observe compaction boundaries; no rewrite or veto result
descs.before_dispatch: Handle an inbound message before the normal model dispatch
descs.before_install: Inspect staged skill or plugin install material from a loaded plugin runtime
descs.before_message_write: Synchronous errors are logged; failed results are ignored
descs.before_model_resolve: Override provider, model, or the run's fallback chain before session messages load
descs.before_prompt_build: Add prompt context, narrow the current turn's submitted tools, or perform authorized post-policy enrichment
descs.before_tool_call: Rewrite tool params, block execution, or require approval
descs.channel_pairing_requested: Observe newly created DM pairing requests
descs.cron_changed: Observe Gateway-owned cron lifecycle changes (added, updated, removed, started, finished, scheduled)
descs.cron_reconciled: Reconcile against the complete Gateway cron state after startup or reload
descs.gateway_start: Start or stop plugin-owned services with the Gateway
descs.gateway_stop: Start or stop plugin-owned services with the Gateway
descs.heartbeat_prompt_contribution: Add context for receipt-owned proactive automation jobs; retains its historical public name
descs.inbound_claim: Claim an inbound message for the plugin that owns its conversation binding
descs.llm_input: Provider input: system prompt, prompt, history
descs.llm_output: Provider output, usage, and the resolved `contextTokenBudget` when available
descs.message_received: Observe inbound content, sender, thread, and metadata
descs.message_sending: Rewrite outbound content or cancel delivery
descs.message_sent: Observe outbound delivery success or failure
descs.model_call_ended: Sanitized provider/model call metadata: timing, outcome, bounded request-id hashes. No prompt or response content.
descs.model_call_started: Sanitized provider/model call metadata: timing, outcome, bounded request-id hashes. No prompt or response content.
descs.reply_dispatch: Own reply generation and dispatch instead of the default model path
descs.reply_payload_sending: Mutate or cancel normalized reply payloads before delivery
descs.skill_changed: Observe committed live-skill create, update, and removal events
descs.tool_result_persist: Synchronous errors are logged; failed results are ignored

terms.failure:block_the_run_tool_call_or_insta: Block the run, tool call, or install
terms.failure:log_and_skip_the_failed_handler_: Log and skip the failed handler; retain other successful results
terms.failure:refuse_durable_intake_without_lo: Refuse durable intake without logging policy exception contents

caveats.deliver: Use the provider-owned callback only when the branch cannot be declared before entering the provider funnel; it is mutually exclusive with `deliver` and `durable`.
caveats.durable: Use the provider-owned callback only when the branch cannot be declared before entering the provider funnel; it is mutually exclusive with `deliver` and `durable`.
caveats.false: | | `visibleReplySent` | Set to `false` only when the provider produced no visible preview or final message.
caveats.message_sent: Core also owns terminal `message_sent` observation when the adapter opts in.

terms.kind:typed_intentional_no_send_reason_af: Typed intentional no-send reason after a modifying hook or payload policy settles. Hook cancellation can also include `cancelReason` and metadata. Core never calls the direct native adapter for a core-owned suppression.
